description: Autonomous on-chain security detective for Base, exposed over the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
name: io.github.jUXTAPOSITION1/vape

environmentVariables.description: Etherscan V2 API key. Without it, contract_source degrades to an honest error.
environmentVariables.name: ETHERSCAN_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Alchemy API key (Base/Eth/Arb/Op). Without it, wallet_trace returns an error.
environmentVariables.name: VAPE_TRACE_ALCHEMY_API

environmentVariables.description: Tavily search key. Falls back to a keyless, less reliable search path if unset.
environmentVariables.name: TAVILY_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Brave Search key, tried if TAVILY_API_KEY unset. Falls back to keyless search.
environmentVariables.name: BRAVE_API_KEY

title: V.A.P.E. — On-Chain Security Detective
